correctness.rationale: Exact symbolic reconstruction confirms the 3×3 moment transfer, determinant as a strictly negative moment-square for any positive nonconstant law, and positive invariant quadratic energy for a fixed step. The real characteristic polynomial consequently has a root above 1. Cone-Perron eigenmatrix on the adjoint must be positive definite because rank one would force a forbidden real eigenvector of an elliptic symplectic-Euler step. This proves exponential mean-square growth uniformly over all deterministic initial vectors, with strict endpoint exclusions verified.

value.rationale: A motivated stability question asks whether an i.i.d. randomized scheduler preserves harmonic-oscillator bounded energy when all individual symplectic steps are stable. The exact sharp dichotomy applies to every positive step law without a small-variance assumption, with an explicit fourth-moment negative certificate and a nontrivial zero-step boundary. The resulting universally quantified stability obstruction is significant for long-horizon geometric integration, not an arbitrary numerical parameter calculation.
